site.audience: coffee lovers, loyalty program members, gift card buyers, general consumers

brief.title: GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual
brief.one_liner: A premium coffeehouse chain offering handcrafted beverages, a loyalty rewards program, gift cards, and convenient store locator.
brief.goal: Drive online ordering, promote seasonal drinks, grow loyalty program membership, and facilitate gift card purchases.

pages.objective: Serve as the main landing page showcasing seasonal drinks, promotions, and quick access to ordering.
Display the full menu organized by categories including drinks, food, and at-home coffee products.
Explain the loyalty rewards program, its tiers, benefits, and encourage sign-ups.
Showcase gift card designs organized by occasion and enable digital gift card purchases.
Help users find nearby store locations using an interactive map and search functionality.

navigation.trigger: Find a store link in header
Find a store link in header

interactions.trigger: User clicks Agree button on cookie consent banner
interactions.expected: Cookie banner dismisses and is hidden

interactions.trigger: User clicks on a footer section heading on mobile
interactions.expected: Footer section expands to reveal links underneath

interactions.trigger: User clicks on a rewards redemption level tab (e.g., 25 Stars, 60 Stars, etc.)
interactions.expected: Tab content switches to show the corresponding reward description

interactions.trigger: User clicks next/previous arrows on featured gift cards carousel
interactions.expected: Carousel slides to show next or previous set of gift card designs

interactions.trigger: User clicks next/previous arrows on category-specific gift card carousels
interactions.expected: Carousel slides to show additional gift card designs in that category

interactions.trigger: User types a location in the search input field
interactions.expected: Suggestions appear below the input and map updates with results
Filter options panel opens to refine store search results

interactions.trigger: User toggles between Pickup and Delivery order types
interactions.expected: Store results update to reflect selected order type

data_display.description: Sidebar navigation listing all menu categories including drinks, food, and at-home coffee.
Three loyalty tiers showing status name, star threshold, and associated benefits.
Tabbed display showing what free items can be redeemed at each star level.
Gift card designs organized by occasion categories with carousel browsing.
Footer organized into columns with links to company info, careers, social impact, business partners, and ordering options.
